metrics.headline: generated
metrics.calc: Generated = profit from completed buy → sell round trips after pool fees, gas and token taxes, in the coin the grid accrues it in: the quote coin it spends. The coin it "stacks" is inventory, shown as Unrealized. A close / stop cash-out sale is not a round trip; its result is in Price change. Per day / week / month / year, the 24h/7d/30d/365d estimates and APR (Generated ÷ capital in, annualized) scale Generated linearly, not compounded, and need 28 min / 3.2h / 13.8h / 7d of history. Total P&L = coins held at today's price + profits paid out − capital in. Price change = Total P&L − Generated.

metrics.headline: generated
metrics.calc: Generated = fees collected + fees still in the position, per coin, minus costs: gas (charged to the native coin), swap fees (in the coin swapped in) and range-move losses (in the coin the move sold, locked in at each move); dollars at today's mid price. Per day / week / month / year, the 24h/7d/30d/365d estimates and APR (Generated ÷ capital in, annualized) scale Generated linearly, not compounded, and need 28 min / 3.2h / 13.8h / 7d of history. Total P&L = position + waiting fees + idle coins at today's price + fees sent out − gas − start value. Price change = Total P&L − Generated (unrealized IL + the coins' market move).
